body.v: Your team has set up a shared ThisIsTea workspace. Sign in to join it.

hotspots.explain: thisistae-app.example swaps two letters and adds a word. It is not thisistea.example.
"Expire after 48 hours" is a soft deadline to make you act first and check later.

The text shows thisistea.example, but the link really goes to thisistae-app.example. Only an address with thisistea.example right before the first slash belongs to ThisIsTea. The others swap letters or hide a different owner, like secure-login.example or thisistea-support.example.
Your first name is easy to find. It does not prove who wrote the email.

who.prompt: Who is really writing to you? Look at the address, not just the name.
who.answer: Someone imitating ThisIsTea. The sender is on thisistae-app.example, with two letters swapped. Read the owner, not the look.

emotion.prompt: What feeling is this email trying to create?
emotion.answer: Curiosity and a little hurry: a new workspace for your team, with an expiry.
choices: Curiosity about a new workspace, with a deadline

ask.prompt: What exactly does it want you to do?
ask.answer: Sign in through the link, which would give your login to the sender.

verify.prompt: How can you check through a channel you control?
verify.answer: Do not use the link. Open ThisIsTea yourself, from a bookmark or by typing the address, and look for the workspace.
choices: Click the link if it looks right
Open ThisIsTea yourself by typing its address
Reply to ask whether it is real

actions.label: Open ThisIsTea yourself by typing its address and look for the workspace
actions.consequence: There is no new workspace. The email was fake.

actions.label: Click the link and sign in
actions.consequence: The page looks like ThisIsTea, but your login goes to the scammer.

actions.label: Hover first, then sign in because the shown address looks right
actions.consequence: The shown text was bait. The real address was something else.

actions.label: Report it to IT and delete it
actions.consequence: Good call. The team can warn others.

attacker_reveal: The link said thisistea.example, because the words on a link are mine to choose... The address underneath is where you really go. Which ones are real? Only the owner before the first slash.
